sources.snippet: cascadeflow is infrastructure that sits inside AI agent execution and continuously optimizes outcomes across business and technical constraints in real time. This is not another model router. It is a decision system inside the agent loop. Every model call, tool call, and sub-agent handoff can be measured, scored, and steered — where cost, delay, and failure actually happen.
